request.prompt:
Create a NEW overall PROP STATE reference for “压闸长横杠·七人持杠承重”. IMAGE 1 is the approved complete stone passage; IMAGE 2 is the approved long beam. Use both original identities directly. The long beam is a SINGLE continuous grey-brown round log, placed across the FRONT of the MOVING northern gate panel, entirely in front of both fixed posts. A small short horizontal cleat is fixed to the moving panel, its ends well inside the posts. Exactly two compact tight hemp-rope loops hug BOTH this cleat and the long beam together near the centre; no suspension ropes, no rope to fixed posts or to the locking pin. The wooden panel and posts may extend upwards to leave usable space above the knee-high stone lid; do not raise stone walls. All stone components remain connected: southern small barred wooden door, two front stone lids, gate position, roofed short segment behind the gate and rock root. Both beam ends extend over clear open ground. This is a dry covered stone snake passage, never a water canal or open trench.
THIS EXACT MOMENT: the through-post locking pin has been removed and is outside this view; the seven helpers have lifted the sliding panel upwards together. The wooden gate is visibly raised in its same two grooves; its short cleat and bound long beam rise with it. The SOUTH feeding door remains closed and barred. Do not show a pin inserted through either post, and do not show a snake outside the passage.
Show EXACTLY SEVEN simple neutral grey clothed human silhouettes solely as a load-position diagram, not new character portraits. Place four fully separable figures along the WEST/left free half of the beam, and THREE along the EAST/right free half. Arrange staggered feet and slight gaps so all seven heads, torsos, two arms and legs are countable; no background people or reflections. These silhouettes stand outside the stone body and lift/hold the beam with hands underneath it, not stand on the lids. Li Dan is not one of these seven and must not be drawn as an eighth spectator. Use a slightly elevated southern three-quarter view with the two groups clearly split either side of the central gate, southern small door foreground, rock at rear. Preserve both roof slabs, the rear roofed segment and continuous side masonry. Include small unobtrusive labels “西侧四人” and “东侧三人” only if useful; labels cannot replace the actual count.
Render one coherent complete overall reference, clean two-dimensional ink contours with lightly hand-painted muted greys and browns, restrained texture, no gritty paper, no photographic lighting, no decorative machinery. 16:9 landscape; use the highest native output the tool provides, do not upscale. Keep the entire object and beam ends inside frame, with margins.
